deployments_detail.use: "Callimacus" AI e-commerce platform (Solomei AI hub) for personalized digital shopping

AI-native e-commerce platform (Callimacus by in-house unit Solomei AI): replaces static product catalog pages with a real-time, multi-agent personalized shopping experience that interprets each visitor's intent and dynamically composes the interface and content. Launched Jan 2026, live in Italy, US and UK with rollout to more markets planned. [Solomei AI (Callimacus platform); Groq inference]

Groq LPU inference infrastructure powering the Callimacus multi-agent system: Solomei AI re-architected and migrated its inference-heavy AI workloads to Groq's LPUs to achieve millisecond-latency token generation required for real-time personalization at scale on the Brunello Cucinelli platform. [Groq (LPU); Solomei AI]

AI analytics and optimization layer: Callimacus captures real-time behavioral events (replacing traditional web analytics) and provides intent-based performance insights, including regional campaign metrics, and suggests tactical adjustments to improve engagement and conversion. [Solomei AI (Callimacus)]

AI applied to supply chain and operations: stated ambitions/early use of AI for supply chain optimization, inventory allocation and environmental-impact analysis, plus Cucinelli's interest in manufacturing 'copilots' for artisanal production rather than purely software tasks. [Solomei AI (Callimacus)]

BrunelloCucinelli.AI conversational website (2024, first Solomei AI product): visitors can ask the AI questions about the brand's philosophy, the life of Brunello Cucinelli and product details, with the system crafting bespoke responses. First public deployment of the Solomei AI / Callimacus approach. [Solomei AI (Callimacus)]

Callimacus AI-native software development kit / content-authoring platform: editorial workflows become conversational, letting the team describe new collections and upload assets while the system autonomously generates the interfaces and decides content display priorities (page-less design). Callimacus SDK released as a product with certified integration partners. [Solomei AI (Callimacus SDK)]

Real-time AI shopping-assistant / product-recommendation agent within Callimacus (agents named e.g. Socrates/Skesis): interprets a shopper request (e.g. a gala dress) and instantly curates complete outfit suggestions, accessories and styling, generating 100+ product recommendations in under one second. [Solomei AI (Callimacus); Groq LPU]
deployments_detail.value: 100+ product recommendations generated in under 1 second

deployments_detail.use: AI editorial and product-content generation: brand storytelling / editorial content generation and product-description optimization, with the multi-agent system dynamically shifting layouts between product-focused and editorial-heavy displays based on detected intent. [Solomei AI (Callimacus)]

Agentic commerce: planned partnerships with Google and Microsoft to enable autonomous AI shopping agents that research, compare and purchase products directly on the Brunello Cucinelli platform, positioned as the next stage of the AI e-commerce roadmap. Announced around the Jan 2026 platform launch but not yet in production. [Google; Microsoft; Solomei AI]
AI-powered e-commerce platform with multi-agent structure for product discovery and shopping experience [Solomei AI]
